newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jewellery processor Xian Diamond to issue A shares.
newsitem.headline: Jewellery processor Xian Diamond to issue A shares.

text.p: Jewellery processor Xian Diamond Industrial Co Ltd has been given approval by the China Securities Regulatory Commission to issue 21 million A shares and list them in Shanghai, a company spokesman said on Monday.
China Southern Securities has been named chief underwriter for the issue, which has been tentatively priced at seven yuan per share, he told Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin.
The pricing and timetable for the offer have yet to be determined, he said. Shanghai Shenyin Wanguo Securities will be listing promoter.

Based in Xian, capital of northwestern Shaanxi province, Xian Diamond specialises in processing and marketing jewelry, with about 85 percent of its products exported to Europe and Southeast Asia, he said.
He said Diamond plans to use money raised from the issue to expand production faci/lities, set up an international jewelry trade centre in Xian and finance a car paint project.
Diamond has 55 million outstanding shares, with 53.625 million legal person shares and 1.375 million staff shares.
The official said Diamond forecast unaudited after-tax profits of 52 million yuan for 1996, compared with 16 million in 1995 and seven million in 1994.
